in_hindi.name: Badmas
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of mace
in_hindi.long_meaning: Badmas एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Badmas is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Baddha-masta’, meaning ‘God of mace’. This name is often associated with Lord Shiva, who is known to hold a mace as one of his weapons.
